messages.subject: Reactive "load to environment"
parts:
Hello!  I'm trying to load an RData file into the global env in a reactive manner, from a drop down list, with the choices loaded in a csv file.

When I run this, however, the RData file doesn't seem to load.  I think I need to make the 'LoadToEnvironment' bit reactive as well, but not sure how that's done...

I've attached the csv file- nothing special there.

Thanks in advance for the help!

Bill Drake



library(shiny)

#RDATA_LISTS.csv is the csv file with the names of the model (RData) files
RD <-read.csv("~/Shiny Apps/BaseApp/RDATA_LIST.csv")

ui <- fluidPage(
  
  sidebarLayout(
    # User selects the RData file to use from choices in the csv loaded above.
    selectInput(inputId="RDFile",
                label = "Select .RData file",
                choices = levels(RD$filepath)
    ),
  ),
  mainPanel(
    plotOutput("plot")
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  RData <- reactive({
    input$RDFile
  })
  
  LoadToEnvironment <- function(RData, env=new.env()) {
    load(input$RDFile, envir=.GlobalEnv)
    return(env)
  }
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
